title: Virtual Compute: egress rate
content:
## Meaning — egress rate

Virtual Compute egress rate: Compute-managed internet transfer; USD per GB after local included transfer.

## Tier values — egress rate

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — egress rate: 0.083.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — egress rate: 0.083.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — egress rate: 0.083.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — egress rate: 0.083.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — egress rate: 0.083.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — egress rate: 0.083.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for egress rate?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has egress rate of 0.083.

## Meaning — included monthly internet transfer in GB

Virtual Compute included monthly internet transfer in GB: Monthly internet transfer included per compute holding; GB decimal.
